undergrad_signals.signal: PAIR (a research group under SVL) hosts an undated BS/MS Research Assistant call; text is real and undergraduate-relevant, but its currency is unverified
undergrad_signals.note: TEXT RE-VERIFIED VERBATIM 2026-08-31 by curl of https://pair.stanford.edu/join (HTTP 200). Present-tense and undergraduate-relevant: 'We are actively seeking applicants for the following two positions:' followed by list items 'BS/MS Research Assistants (see more info below)' and 'Postdoctoral Fellows'. Body: 'PAIR call for BS/MS research assistants - We are looking for students to work on several amazing projects that involve Deep reinforcement and imitation learning on physical robots. Visual representation learning for physical interaction. Deep learning-based methods for planning & control. Simulation to real-world policy transfer. Large-scale robotic teleoperation for robotic manipulation tasks.' And: 'The primary qualification is interest in doing research, and if you have that we encourage you to apply even if you have not had prior research experience or have limited experience with AI.' REQUIRED (page heading 'Requirements', source wording): 'At least 10 hours per week of expected commitment.' / 'Python/C++ programming' / 'Experience in a subset of Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning, or Robotics'. PREFERRED (page heading 'More details', source wording): 'Junior and 1st year MS preferred.' / 'Graduating Seniors and MS students considered on a case by case basis.' / 'Additional bonus points for: more in-depth coursework (Convex Optimization, Advanced Reinforcement Learning, Graphical Models, Advanced Robotics, Manipulation), familiarity with deep learning frameworks such as TF/PyTorch, and experience with using simulators such as MuJoCo, cloud infrastructure, or mobile app development'. WHY DOWNGRADED FROM 'verified' TO 'likely' - four independent staleness findings, each from a page fetched 2026-08-31: (1) FROZEN CONTENT: the live page body is byte-for-byte identical to the Internet Archive capture of 2024-11-02. SHA-1 of the live 13,983-byte response, base32-encoded, is 6BULNES2J5TIGRWOQFHGJJTRLNT2DGWQ, exactly the CDX digest recorded for timestamp 20241102175434. The posting has therefore not been touched in ~22 months. (2) The Wayback CDX index (collapse=digest) returns only four distinct versions of this page ever: 2018-11-13, 2019-07-17, 2021-06-22, 2024-11-02. It is a standing page, not a refreshed job posting. (3) The HTTP Last-Modified header reads 'Sun, 06 Apr 2025 22:18:50 GMT', but the identical timestamp is returned for /people and /publications too, and the content hash proves the body did not change then - so that header records a site-wide redeploy, not an edit to the recruiting text. (4) APPLICATION CHANNEL UNVERIFIABLE: the 'this form' link https://forms.gle/6CJYNmzmcGvf9yZA8 resolves to https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeRXEtlm6b405zY4m9f-ykJqxWN4TIVrwsoqZmIcnIWcQLIAA/viewform which returns HTTP 401 behind a Google sign-in wall ('You must sign in to access this content'). It could not be confirmed that the form still accepts responses. A signed-in Stanford student may well be able to open it; this agent cannot. ALSO: PAIR's own publications page lists nothing after 2024 (year counts 2017:5, 2018:8, 2019:12, 2020:12, 2021:18, 2022:3, 2023:7, 2024:6, and zero for 2025 or 2026), and PAIR's people page still lists Silvio Savarese as a current 'Associate Professor' while Stanford Profiles now shows him as 'Adjunct Professor, Computer Science' - the PAIR microsite is not being maintained even though SVL is very active. The page also never states that Fei-Fei Li personally supervises these RAs; she is simply the first of three faculty listed under PAIR 'Current Members > Faculty Members'.
